title: Apple approved the public TestFlight link; the clash fixes, 21 languages and the iPad model are in the release queue
headline: Beta App Review approved the news app (0.4.24, build 205) at 20:48: the public TestFlight link works, so anyone can install it now. The App Store listing itself still waits for review. In the release queue on iOS: the clash fixes, busy and free picks, split my time and the shared rules (v0.4.51 and v0.4.52), and the 21 cultures with the globe button and English by default. The RiskMandate app on TestFlight has Apple's on-device model in a Workbench (0.4.48). The web app has 21 cultures. /contribute/ has its words and the sign-ups lane; the page is being built. All five conductors check in hourly; security found nothing above low.

stats.label: cultures, in the web app and coming in iOS

for_you.detail: It now serves build 205. Put it in the team WhatsApp group and the collaborators' group; Andrew can install it tonight. The newer builds (clash fixes, languages) reach the link after Apple reviews them; the web app at promptugal.news /app/ has them first.
Android: main as default branch, Environment promote limited to main, the Play credential. OpenRouter: the top-up dev.verify@ waits on.
